content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The clear typography and clinic photo work, but the oversized timetable and widely spaced service labels make the phone page unnecessarily long.",
  "desktopNote": "The branded hero feels considered, but oversized section headings and sparse lower-page layouts weaken the overall rhythm.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 2,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Replace the five identical timetable bars with one compact weekday-hours row beside the booking action, and remove the repeated hours and arrival instructions from the footer.",
    "Tighten the service grid and section padding on both screens; reduce desktop section-heading sizes so short sections do not occupy nearly a full screen.",
    "On phone, remove the extra header contact row while retaining the fixed bottom bar, and make the clinic photo wider and higher in the hero."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop: the footer repeats the opening hours and arrival instructions already presented in the timetable section."
  ]
}
